    Frequently Asked Questions

    Here are some of the most common questions we get asked.

    Q.1 Who Is Tilak StoneArts?

    +

    Tilak Stone Arts is a leading manufacturer and exporter of handcrafted Marble Temple, Marble Idols, Pooja Room Designs, Sculptures and Home Décor products. Based in Kishangarh, Rajasthan, we combine traditional craftsmanship with premium-quality marble to create timeless spiritual and decorative masterpieces.

    Q.2 What Products Does TilakStone Arts Specialize In?

    +

    We specialize in handcrafted Marble Temples, Pooja Room Designs, Marble Idols religious sculptures, decorative stone artifacts, garden statues, and customized marble creations. Our collection includes Ganesha idols, Radha Krishna Idols, Hanuman Idols, Shiv Parivar Idols like Gods Idol, Home Décor Collection and Wall Arts collections Marble Mandirs, and bespoke Temple projects.

    Q.3 What Types Of Marble Do You Use?

    +

    We work with premium-quality materials, including Vietnam Pure White Marble, Makrana Marble, Black Marble, Cultured Marble, Sandstone, Antique Italian Marble, Oakwood Stone, and other natural stones depending on the project requirements.

    Q.4 Do You Offer Customized Marble Idols And Temples?

    +

    Yes. We provide fully customized solutions for marble idols, temples, pooja rooms, and architectural stone projects. Customers can choose dimensions, marble type, design details, carving styles, and finishes according to their requirements.

    Q.5 Do You Provide Complete Pooja Room Solutions?

    +

    Yes. We offer complete marble pooja room solutions, including temple structures, decorative panels, columns, arches, backdrops, and customized spiritual interiors, Gods Idols.

    Q.6 Are Your Marble Idols Handmade?

    +

    Yes. Every marble idol is handcrafted by experienced artisans 20 year experience who specialize in traditional stone carving techniques. This ensures exceptional detailing, quality, and uniqueness in every piece.

    Q.7 Do You Ship Marble Idols And Temples Across India?

    +

    Yes. We deliver our products across India with secure packaging and reliable logistics support to ensure safe transportation.

    Q.8 Do You Offer International Shipping?

    +

    Yes. Tilak Stone Arts exports marble idols, temples, and sculptures worldwide. We have experience serving International customers in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Europe, and many other countries.

    Q.9 How do you ensure safe delivery of marble products?

    +

    We use export-grade packaging methods, including protective wrapping, cushioning materials, and wooden crate packaging when required. Each shipment is carefully prepared to minimize the risk of damage during transit.

    Q.10 Why choose Tilak Stone Arts?

    +

    Customers choose Tilak Stone Arts for premium craftsmanship, high-quality marble, customization expertise, secure packaging, worldwide delivery, and dedicated customer support. Our focus is on creating marble masterpieces that combine beauty, durability, and spiritual significance.

    Q.11 How Can I Get A Quotation For A Marble Idol Or Temple?

    +

    You can contact us through WhatsApp, Phone, Email, or our inquiry form. Simply share your requirements, dimensions, preferred marble type, and reference images (if available), and our team will provide a customized quotation.
